description: This source file implements a class and functions for transforming shader ASTs by separating array-returning expressions into temporary variables, to simplify complex expressions involving arrays in shader code.

classes.name: SeparateExpressionsTraverser
classes.description: A traverser class that walks the AST to identify and separate array expressions into temporary variables.

methods.name: SeparateExpressionsTraverser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the traverser with a symbol table.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Visits binary nodes to identify array expressions and hoist them into temporary variables.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits aggregate nodes (like constructors or function calls) to identify array expressions for separation.

methods.name: nextIteration
methods.description: Resets the traverser's state for the next iteration.
